title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
slides: Meta quietly launched Style Sketch — but why the silence?
It's a fashion AI app for generating outfit sketches
But Meta buried it outside its main apps entirely
You can now test it without a Meta account
Try one outfit design today and judge the output
thread_text:
1. Meta's silent AI drop

Meta quietly launched Style Sketch, a fashion AI app for generating outfit sketches — and buried it outside its main apps entirely.

2. Fashion AI, no account needed

You can now test Style Sketch without a Meta account, so there's no barrier to trying it out.

3. Why hide it?

Meta kept Style Sketch out of its main apps, raising questions about whether this is a test or a strategic retreat.

4. Try before you judge

Generate one outfit design today and judge the output yourself — no sign-up required.

5. Your turn to test

Try one outfit design today and judge the output. Does it make sense to save time if you have to edit twice? Test it on a real post this week.

instagram.caption:
Meta built a fashion AI that generates outfit sketches, then launched it outside its main apps entirely.

It's called Style Sketch. 🧵 You can try it without a Meta account.

That silence is the story: no push notification, no banner in Instagram, no mention in the main feed. A test they didn't want you to notice, or a retreat before the backlash?

If you design or post outfits, you can generate one sketch today and check the output yourself. No sign-up.

Generate one look now: does it save you time, or do you end up editing twice? 👗
